messages.text:
I will use Team Plasma's science to bring
out my Pokémon's greatest power!{be01}

Why are you strong? You're just a normal
person...not even that! You're just a kid!

We in Team Plasma force our Pokémon to
use their powers to the max!{be01}
Release Pokémon? Why would we do
something so bothersome as that?
